question: Will Country X conduct airstrikes on targets in Country Y before October 15, 2026?
description: This market resolves based on credible reporting of military action. Confirmation requires reporting by at least two of: Reuters, AP, AFP, or an official statement from either government.
resolutionRules: Resolves YES if, before 23:59 UTC on 2026-10-15, Country X's armed forces conduct one or more airstrikes on territory controlled by Country Y, as confirmed per the description. Resolves NO otherwise.
